SOURCE_AUTHORITY.START_SINGLE_TICKET_STATUS_EVIDENCE: sealed LOCAL_OPTIMUM=true, ACCEPTED_MOVE_COUNT=0, TERMINAL_BEST_DELTA=0, FULL_PASSES>=1, FINAL.CANONICAL_RECOUNT=PASS

DRAW_SPACE.CONSTRUCTION: all_main_draw_masks(49, 6) once, shared read-only by every worker

STRUCTURE.SLOT_CONVENTION: index into the normalized START ticket order

OPERATOR.TRIPLES: every unordered x < y < z of twelve-side F3 numbers
OPERATOR.SLOTS: a in SUPPORT(x), b in SUPPORT(y), c in SUPPORT(z), ascending products
OPERATOR.FORWARD: x: a -> b, y: b -> c, z: c -> a
OPERATOR.REVERSE: x: a -> c, z: c -> b, y: b -> a
OPERATOR.CODE_CONVENTION: x-y-z@abc:D, one base-36 digit per slot, D in {F, R}
OPERATOR.SYMMETRY_QUOTIENT: NOT_USED; every legal unique candidate is scored

INVARIANTS: exactly three ticket slots differ from START, all twelve-side
20 legal distinct tickets of six distinct numbers
every F2 support unchanged slot for slot
no number crosses the 12/8 component boundary
8-ticket component equal up to canonical ticket ordering

SCORES.TIE_BREAK: maximum exact count, then ascending normalized SHA-256

CLAIM_SCOPE: Exact for the defined twelve-side F3 three-ticket occurrence-cycle family of START only. Not a generic N3 closure, not an N2 result, and not a global K20 optimality claim.
